link-flow/1.formula: sum over the window of w_generators[t] x p0[t], net (reverse flow subtracts); PyPSA sign: p0 > 0 is withdrawal at bus0, p1 < 0 delivery at bus1, p1 = -eta[t] x p0[t]; eta[t] is links_t.efficiency[link][t] where that column exists, else the static efficiency
link-flow/1.validity: verified LP solve and finite, non-negative generator weights (else unverified_solve); no non-empty bus2 or later port on the Link, a blank or NaN port being empty (unsupported_link_ports); p0, p1 and eta[t] present and finite at every window snapshot, a NaN in links_t.efficiency never falling back to the static value (invalid_or_missing_raw_data); |p1[t] + eta[t] x p0[t]| <= FLOW_TOLERANCE x max(1, |p0[t]|) at every window snapshot (inconsistent_link_flow). Refusals: unknown_link, unsupported_snapshot_scope (multi-period network)
